summary: Bill and Garfield watch Calvin, Goku, and Linus leave. Calvin and Goku depart together despite their continuing conflict, while Linus travels separately; Bill can only speculate about the reason. The first version-3 vessels, Heaven-9 and Heaven-10, are specially equipped for a destination Bill expects may hold other probes. FAITH has avoided Alpha Centauri because another superpower may have chosen it, and the group agrees to offer Medeiros neither warning nor quarter.

introducing.name: Heaven-9
introducing.description: A version-3 HEAVEN vessel equipped for a destination that may contain other probes. Oversized SURGE drives and reactors give it a maximum acceleration of 10 g. A smaller shielded reactor lets it coast through a system with its main reactor off, making it difficult to detect except at close range. It carries expanded ship-buster and scout complements, rail guns, and twin SUDDAR-jamming emitters intended to overwhelm nearby detectors with white noise.

updates.description: A self-replicating spacecraft designed to travel between star systems and construct new copies of itself along the way. Interstellar use became possible after a breakthrough in subspace theory, and such probes are central to a competitive international colonization effort. Their exponential replication could eventually explore the galaxy, but practical self-construction remains the central obstacle.
Tiny, single-purpose devices used for work below ROAMer scale; their flexibility is limited. Nanites alone cannot supply the energy needed to process high-grade materials for self-construction.

updates.current_state: In 2150, it avoids Alpha Centauri because another superpower may already have selected it.
